adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/adapters/rest.js.es6`, `basePath(store, type)` was changed to match admin models via `ADMIN_MODELS.indexOf(type.replace('_', '-'))`. JS `String#replace` without a regex only replaces the first underscore, so any future model type containing multiple underscores would not be fully normalized to the hyphenated form used in `ADMIN_MODELS` and would fall through to `"/"` instead of `"/admin/"`. The diff doesn’t show an immediate break for current types (`embeddable_host`, `site_customization`), but it is a real, diff-grounded maintainability/edge-case issue created by this change.
